T: For England, James. And for dinner.
D: Bond races to stop a former friend from using a stolen Soviet satellite weapon.
P: Serve the drinks when Bond orders his vodka martini at the casino in Monte Carlo.
S: Buckwheat pancakes with crème fraîche, salmon roe and chives, frozen vodka alongside
Buckwheat blini cooked small in butter, topped with crème fraîche, salmon roe and chives, served on ice beside a bottle of frozen vodka.
the baccarat table in Monte Carlo

Crisp-edged chickpea pancakes from the Riviera cut into wedges, topped with black olive and anchovy tapenade, roasted cherry tomatoes and basil. Whisk 150g chickpea flour with 300ml water, 3 tbsp olive oil and salt and rest 30 minutes. Heat an oiled ovenproof pan in a 240C oven, pour in half the batter and bake 10 minutes until set and crisp at the edges. Repeat. Blitz 150g pitted black olives with 4 anchovies, 1 tbsp capers, a garlic clove and olive oil. Roast 250g cherry tomatoes for 10 minutes. Cut the socca into wedges and top.
Baked yeast buns filled with beef, onion and dill
Soft yeasted buns filled with beef mince, onion and dill, baked at 200C for 18 minutes, brushed with butter.
M: Beef fillet strips with mushrooms, paprika, brandy and sour cream sauce
Beef fillet strips seared fast, mushrooms and onion cooked in butter, paprika, a splash of brandy, stock and sour cream, over buttered egg noodles.
Cuban mojo pork, black beans and plantain
the satellite dish hidden in a Cuban lake

Pork shoulder marinated in sour orange mojo, slow roasted and pulled, with black beans and rice, fried sweet plantain and quick pickled red onion. Blitz the juice of 2 oranges and 2 limes with 6 garlic cloves, 2 tsp cumin and oregano and marinate 1.5kg pork shoulder overnight. Roast covered at 160C for 4 hours and pull. Cook 300g rice, then fold through a drained, warmed tin of black beans. Slice 2 ripe plantains and fry until caramelised. Toss a sliced red onion in lime juice and salt for 20 minutes.
W: Syrniki cottage cheese pancakes, berry jam
Pan fried cottage cheese patties, golden outside, with warm jam and sour cream

Little golden cottage cheese pancakes fried in butter until crisp outside and soft inside, with cold sour cream and warm berry jam. Mix 500g cottage cheese, 2 eggs, 3 tbsp sugar, 1 tsp vanilla and 80g flour. Shape 12 small patties, dust in flour and fry in butter for 3 minutes a side until golden. Warm 4 tbsp berry jam. Serve with 150g sour cream and the jam.
K: Vodka and dry vermouth shaken hard and strained, with a lemon twist
60ml vodka and 10ml dry vermouth shaken hard with ice, strained into a chilled glass, lemon peel.

note.text: Business is business, Mr. Bond. The vodka is on me, but the information will cost you.

steps.text: Mix the flour, yeast and warm milk and rest until bubbly.
Cook small spoonfuls in butter until golden.
Top each with creme fraiche, salmon roe and snipped chives.
Serve beside frozen vodka.
Mix the flour, yeast, warm milk and some butter into a soft dough.
Prove.
Fry the mince with the onion and dill and cool.
Fill rounds of dough and seal.
Bake at 200C.
Brush with melted butter.
Slice the beef, mushrooms and onion.
Sear the beef fast and set aside.
Cook the mushrooms and onion in the butter, add the paprika and flame the brandy.
Add the stock and simmer.
Cook the noodles and butter them.
Stir in the sour cream off the heat and return the beef.

dishes.n: Syrniki cottage cheese pancakes, berry jam

steps.text: Mix the cottage cheese, eggs, sugar, vanilla and some of the flour.
Shape small patties and dust in the remaining flour.
Fry in butter until golden.
Warm the jam.
Serve with sour cream and the jam.
Shake the vodka and vermouth hard with ice, one drink at a time.
Strain into chilled martini glasses and twist lemon peel over the top.

s.note: Buckwheat pancakes with crème fraîche, salmon roe and chives, frozen vodka alongside
s.how: Mix 150g buckwheat flour, 7g yeast and 250ml warm milk and rest an hour. Cook small spoonfuls in butter until golden. Top each with crème fraîche, salmon roe and snipped chives. Serve beside frozen vodka.

s.note: Baked yeast buns filled with beef, onion and dill
s.how: Mix 400g flour, 7g yeast, 250ml warm milk and 30g butter into a soft dough and prove an hour. Fry 400g beef mince with an onion and dill and cool. Fill 12 rounds, seal and bake at 200C for 18 minutes. Brush with butter.

m.note: Beef fillet strips with mushrooms, paprika, brandy and sour cream sauce
m.how: Sear 600g beef fillet strips fast and set aside. Cook 300g mushrooms and an onion in 30g butter, add 1 tsp paprika and flame 30ml brandy. Add 200ml stock, then stir in 200g sour cream off the heat and return the beef. Serve over 400g buttered egg noodles.

w.n: Syrniki cottage cheese pancakes, berry jam
w.note: Pan fried cottage cheese patties, golden outside, with warm jam and sour cream
w.how: Mix 500g cottage cheese, 2 eggs, 3 tbsp sugar, 1 tsp vanilla and 80g flour. Shape 12 small patties, dust in flour and fry in butter for 3 minutes a side until golden. Warm 4 tbsp berry jam. Serve with 150g sour cream and the jam.

d.note: Vodka and dry vermouth shaken hard and strained, with a lemon twist
d.how: For each drink, shake 60ml vodka and 10ml dry vermouth hard with ice. Strain into a chilled martini glass and twist a strip of lemon peel over the top. Makes four.
